Limitations: Per-frame managed allocations only; native/driver allocations not counted.
Process memory includes runtime, Vulkan driver mappings and earlier workloads.
P95 is individual frame latency; table time is median of batch means.
CPU utilization is process TotalProcessorTime over wall clock, normalized to one logical core.
Each frame includes full GPU round-trip: command record, submit, fence wait and host readback copy.
Fixed scenes reuse texture/caches across frames; -changing scenes force coverage misses.
Quality gate compares against the original's GPU output as ground truth.
